tools.name: landed_cost
tools.description: Calculate US import duty and landed cost estimates. Give hts_code when you know it and this returns the calculated base duty and trade actions (Section 301, Section 232, Section 338, AD/CVD and others), estimated duty, fees and import cost. When estimate_status is partial, part of the duty is undete

tools.name: classify_hts
tools.description: Find the US Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification for a product. Returns candidate HTS codes with their official descriptions and base duty rates. Use when the user wants the code itself rather than a cost. Not charged: it does not use a duty lookup.

tools.name: policy_changes_since
tools.description: List US trade policy changes Gateway has published since a given date: new tariff actions, rate changes, effective dates and expirations, each with its official source. Also returns, under upcoming, earlier entries for changes announced or proposed but not yet in force. Use to answer "what changed r

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "landed_cost" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
